statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the static homepage and all three linked legal-policy templates.

page.notes: Small public disclaimer/legal site. No client application, forms, authentication, media, overlays, or app-like interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated dark media screenshot plus computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: With prefers-color-scheme: dark active, computed color-scheme remained normal and body stayed rgb(255,255,255) / rgb(34,34,34); dark and default screenshots were identical.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced-motion animation and computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active there were no animations, but html still computed scroll-behavior: smooth with no reduced-motion override.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit plus emulated prefers-contrast computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found no contrast violations, and the prefers-contrast probe retained visible #222 text on a white/gray surface.
The audited site is a static document set with no state swaps, SPA routes, or app-like transition to animate.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited site is a static document set with no state swaps, SPA routes, or app-like transition to animate.

checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-linked animation, animation timeline, or client-authored script/scroll listener; the static pages avoid main-thread scroll effects.
No gesture-driven, draggable, swipe, carousel, or scroll-snap interface exists on these static documents.
checkOutcomes.reason: No gesture-driven, draggable, swipe, carousel, or scroll-snap interface exists on these static documents.

checkOutcomes.evidence: There is no sticky or affixed chrome whose state needs to react to scrolling.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no sticky or affixed chrome whose state needs to react to scrolling.

checkOutcomes.evidence: There are no tooltips, popovers, menus, or floating overlays to anchor.
checkOutcomes.reason: There are no tooltips, popovers, menus, or floating overlays to anchor.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile screenshots, DOM links, and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Policy navigation uses descriptive footer links and policy pages expose prominent page headings; keyboard focus receives the browser focus outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots and overlay DOM count
checkOutcomes.evidence: Load screenshots and DOM show no pop-up, consent wall, interstitial, or overlay obscuring the content.
No overlay, disclosure widget, picker, or rich custom control exists on the audited pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No overlay, disclosure widget, picker, or rich custom control exists on the audited pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show a restrained logo header, content column, and footer with no competing application chrome or advertising.
At 360x800 both homepage and long privacy template reported scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360, zero horizontal overflow, and CLS 0.
The small static templates do not reuse a component in materially different container contexts; viewport-based footer stacking is sufficient for the observed use.
checkOutcomes.reason: The small static templates do not reuse a component in materially different container contexts; viewport-based footer stacking is sufficient for the observed use.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Keyboard focus is visible, but all measured inline links are only 17px high, well below a comfortable touch target, including the primary abuse email and footer policy links.
The first viewport explains that the domain hosts survey landing pages and visibly directs abuse reports to a labelled support email; legal pages name their subject with a prominent heading.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct fetch of linked and intended policy URLs
checkOutcomes.evidence: The privacy policy tells users to open its Cookies Policy but links to /assets/cookies-policy.html, which returned HTTP 404; the actual page is /assets/cookie.html.

checkOutcomes.method: Fetch probes for nonexistent routes and broken linked URL
checkOutcomes.evidence: A missing root route returned HTTP 200 with only “empty OK”, while the broken policy URL returned a generic nginx 404 with no route back or recovery action.
Lighthouse measured LCP 1.1s, CLS 0 and TBT 0ms; trace measured LCP 563ms and TBT 0ms.
Mobile layout observation after 2.5s recorded CLS 0 and no layout shifts on both homepage and privacy template.
Trace and mobile layout observers recorded zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse diagnostics plus HAR summary confirmed against DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is fast and only 23.5KB, but Lighthouse identified about 14KiB of avoidable cache-lifetime waste and a render-blocking stylesheet; the image is the dominant 18.7KB request.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary and rendered script inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR contained only six requests and 23.5KB transferred, no third party bytes, and only a 729-byte Cloudflare email decoder script; no large bundle or duplicate-code signal exists.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection and Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The single meaningful image has descriptive alt text, links have readable names and real hrefs, and the site uses header/main/footer landmarks; no form or custom control requires ARIA.
Lighthouse color-contrast audit passed and visual review found dark text on light surfaces and white footer text on #526176.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM heading inventory, legal-page DOM, and Lighthouse corroboration
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has no h1 and begins its only section heading at h3; policy pages jump from h1 to h3. Focus is visible, but the heading hierarchy does not represent document structure.
Desktop and 360px screenshots show readable 16px text, bounded line length, no clipping, and coherent wrapping on long legal content.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport DOM probe, Lighthouse meta-viewport audit, and mobile layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Every audited page uses user-scalable=no with maximum-scale=1.0; Lighthouse flags this as preventing user zoom. Mobile reflow itself has no overflow and there is no media requiring captions.
Lighthouse recorded no browser console errors or uncaught exceptions.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, Lighthouse unsized-image audit, and image primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document has a valid HTML doctype and UTF-8, but the logo omits width and height attributes; the image audit also found a 961px source displayed at 200px with no srcset.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practice diagnostics and DOM/script inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found no deprecated APIs or inspector issues; DOM inspection found no permission prompts, forms with paste prevention, or client application runtime.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM across each representative template and Lighthouse SEO audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: All four distinct pages use the same generic title “ROWOON SERVICE LTD” and none has a meta description; the homepage also lacks an h1.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO plus robots and viewport probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Anchors use real hrefs and content is mobile-reflowed, but robots.txt contains a non-standard “empty OK” line flagged invalid by Lighthouse, and the viewport disables scaling.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM canonical probe, sitemap/route fetches, and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public pages return 200 and are not noindex, but expose no canonical links; sitemap.xml returns the literal text “empty OK”, and unknown root URLs soft-404 with HTTP 200.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probe across representative templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: The organization/home page and policy documents expose no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD, so shared links lack page-specific preview/entity metadata.

checkOutcomes.method: Security headers, cookies, HAR, and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS and nosniff are present and no cookies/mixed content were observed, but CSP is absent and HSTS is only max-age=1 second.

checkOutcomes.method: Cookies, trackers, HAR, and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: The observed site set no cookies, loaded no third-party origins or known trackers, transferred no third-party bytes, and exposed no secrets.
No authentication or permission-requesting feature exists on this public static document set.
checkOutcomes.reason: No authentication or permission-requesting feature exists on this public static document set.

checkOutcomes.evidence: CSP/frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options are absent, as are Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; the page therefore lacks basic clickjacking and browser capability restrictions.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw-HTML versus rendered-DOM discoverability primitive and crawler screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability comparison found 100% rendered-content coverage in raw HTML on both home and privacy pages; content is fully available without JavaScript.
The static pages have no custom overlays or asynchronous app state; DOM, screenshots and zero console errors show a stable native-document runtime.
This public informational/legal document set is not an app and has no offline-critical transactional flow; installability is not proportionate to its purpose.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public informational/legal document set is not an app and has no offline-critical transactional flow; installability is not proportionate to its purpose.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct failed-route and broken-link fetch probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The linked Cookies Policy returns a generic nginx 404 without site navigation, while an unknown root URL returns HTTP 200 with an empty “empty OK” body, obscuring failure state.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM across templates and Lighthouse html-has-lang audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: All representative documents render English text but the html element has no lang attribute; Lighthouse confirms the accessibility/language failure.
The audited static policy and disclaimer pages display no dates, numbers, currencies, durations, or user-selectable locale data requiring Intl formatting.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited static policy and disclaimer pages display no dates, numbers, currencies, durations, or user-selectable locale data requiring Intl formatting.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited pages contain no events, times, recurrence, time-zone conversion, or DST-sensitive state.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited pages contain no events, times, recurrence, time-zone conversion, or DST-sensitive state.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshots, DOM, cookies, and tracker inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No consent wall, ad, upsell, forced continuity, preselected option, or disguised control appeared on any audited page; contact and legal links are plainly labelled.
No user-input form exists on the audited static pages, so there is no validation/error interaction to exercise.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user-input form exists on the audited static pages, so there is no validation/error interaction to exercise.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No input fields or sign-in/address/payment form exists on the audited pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No input fields or sign-in/address/payment form exists on the audited pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited domain explicitly conducts no purchase flow and exposes no subscription, authentication, consent-setting, or account-management interface.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited domain explicitly conducts no purchase flow and exposes no subscription, authentication, consent-setting, or account-management interface.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, image primitive, and Lighthouse image diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is only 23.5KB, but its 18.7KB logo dominates transfer, is 961px wide for a 200px display, lacks srcset, and lacks intrinsic dimensions; Lighthouse estimates about 16KiB image-delivery savings.
HAR shows six small requests and no background/third-party fetches; trace and layout observers recorded no long tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, tracker, media, and animation probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: No third-party bytes, trackers, fonts, video, audio, autoplay, or animation were observed; total transfer was 23.5KB.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The single heap summary is proportionate: 30,159 nodes and about 1.06MB total self size for the loaded static page, with no large application object population.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The heap summary has no Detached* constructor among retained populations, and DOM inspection finds no client-authored scripts, timers, or interaction handlers that could accumulate across the static session.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The emulated dark condition matched, but color-scheme stayed normal and the page remained white with #222 text; dark/default captures were identical.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and define paired surface/text tokens with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme query, preserving tested contrast in both schemes.

findings.summary: Smooth scrolling remains enabled when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe reported reduce=true and computed scroll-behavior: smooth.
findings.suggestedFix: Place scroll-behavior: smooth behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, or reset it to auto inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Important inline links have undersized touch targets.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe measured every email, telephone, and policy link at only 17px high, despite those being the primary actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Give action and footer links enough block/inline padding to produce at least a 24px WCAG floor and preferably about 44px on touch layouts, without crowding adjacent targets.

findings.summary: The Privacy Policy’s Cookies Policy link is broken.
findings.evidence: A direct fetch of the authored ./cookies-policy.html link returned 404, while the actual ./cookie.html page returned 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Change the privacy-policy href to ./cookie.html and add an automated internal-link check so legal routes cannot regress.

findings.summary: Missing routes do not provide a clear, recoverable site error state.
findings.evidence: An unknown root route returned 200 with “empty OK”; the broken asset route returned a generic nginx 404 with no home or support link.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a true 404 and render a branded, semantic error page with a concise explanation plus links to home and support.

findings.summary: Static assets leave small but measurable delivery savings.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated about 14KiB cache savings and flagged one render-blocking stylesheet; HAR shows the logo is 18.7KB of the 23.5KB load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set long immutable caching for fingerprinted static assets and keep critical above-the-fold CSS minimal; verify the tiny stylesheet strategy against repeat-view performance.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy does not expose the page structure.
findings.evidence: The homepage has no h1 and only an h3; policy templates jump directly from h1 to h3.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 to the homepage and use h2 for each top-level policy/disclaimer section, nesting h3 only beneath an h2.

findings.summary: The viewport configuration prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: All templates specify user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.0; Lighthouse failed the meta-viewport accessibility audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and remove user-scalable=no, maximum-scale=1, and minimum-scale=1 restrictions.

findings.summary: The logo lacks intrinsic dimensions and responsive source selection.
findings.evidence: Image inspection found no width/height attributes or srcset and a 961px source rendered at 200px; Lighthouse failed unsized-images and estimated about 16KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate width and height attributes, export a smaller WebP/AVIF logo, and provide srcset/sizes if multiple rendered densities are needed.

findings.summary: Distinct public pages share a generic title and have no meta descriptions.
findings.evidence: Homepage, privacy, user agreement, and cookie templates all title themselves “ROWOON SERVICE LTD”; no meta description was present, and Lighthouse failed meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each route a unique intent-led title and concise page-specific meta description, such as “Privacy Policy | Rowoon Service”.

findings.summary: Crawler indexing signals are incomplete and internally inconsistent.
findings.evidence: No canonical links exist, sitemap.xml contains only “empty OK”, robots.txt includes that invalid line, and unknown root paths soft-404 with HTTP 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid robots.txt, a real XML sitemap listing canonical public URLs, canonical link elements, and correct 404 status codes for unknown routes.

findings.summary: Public organization and legal pages lack share-preview and structured metadata.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add page-specific Open Graph title/description/url metadata and accurate Organization JSON-LD on the homepage; keep policy metadata aligned with visible content.

findings.summary: Basic browser-enforced security policies are missing or ineffective.
findings.evidence: Headers show no CSP, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; HSTS is max-age=1 second.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP (including frame-ancestors), meaningful HSTS duration after validating HTTPS coverage, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; retain nosniff.

findings.summary: The document language is not declared.
findings.evidence: The html element has no lang on any audited template; Lighthouse failed html-has-lang.
findings.suggestedFix: Set <html lang="en"> on every template (and dir only where content direction requires it), then preserve language metadata in generated survey landing pages.
